name: io.github.BlockRunAI/blockrun-mcp
description: Web search, deep research, prediction markets & crypto data for AI agents. Pay per call via x402.

environmentVariables.description: Optional: EVM private key (0x-prefixed hex) for USDC payments on Base; also the Polymarket signer. If not set, a wallet is auto-generated.
environmentVariables.name: BLOCKRUN_WALLET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional: Solana private key (bs58) for USDC payments on Solana. Setting it selects the Solana chain. If not set, a wallet is auto-generated.
environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_WALLET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Optional: BlockRun account API key; bills your prepaid balance instead of a wallet (no per-call network fee). Takes priority over a wallet when set.
environmentVariables.name: BLOCKRUN_API_KEY
